chunks: And he (peace be upon him) said:
Two types of persons will fall into ruin over me: The one who loves exaggerates and the other who lays false and baseless blames.

key_terms.بَاهِتٌ مُفْتَرٍ: Baseless blamer (one who speaks without knowledge, attributing falsehood)
key_terms.مُحِبٌّ مُفْرِطٌ: Exaggerating lover (one who goes to extremes in love)

ai.seo_question: What are the two extremes that lead to ruin regarding the Imams according to Nahj al-Balagha?
ai.summary: Imam Ali (peace be upon him) identifies two extremes that lead to spiritual ruin regarding his person: excessive love that leads to exaggeration (ghuluww) and baseless blame or ignorance (bahat) that leads to false attribution. This hadith highlights the balance required in recognizing the Imams, a concept central to Shia Usul al-Din, where the Imam is revered as a divine proof but not deified. The 'baseless blamer' (bahit) represents those who deny the Imam's divinely appointed status due to ignorance, while the 'excessive lover' distorts his human reality into divine status.
